intro.text: A place in the domain of King Wednegon after the Lord Ruler's Ascension, perhaps the name of his kingdom or of a city in it.

items.text: The Deepness had damaged Darrelnai's food stores before the Ascension, and shortages lasted long after. Wednegon blamed the hunger for his soldiers' failure against the koloss; he was said to be the last leader to resist the Lord Ruler in battle.
